review_candidates.title: ASML | Cleanroom Operator | 2 ploegen
review_candidates.description: Functieomschrijving Cleanroom Operator CRL (2-ploegen) | Veldhoven Functieomschrijving Wil jij een cruciale spil vormen binnen de geavanceerde cleanroom van de wereldleider in chiptechnologie? Als Cleanroom Operator CRL SI&P Support bij ASML in Veldhoven zorg jij ervoor dat de machinebouwers en integratie-engineers op de vloer exact op tijd de juiste materialen en modules tot hun beschikking hebben. Binnen de afdeling Clean Room Logistics (CRL) ondersteun je het System Integration & Production (SI&P) proces, waar de meest complexe lithografiesystemen ter wereld stap voor stap worden geassembleerd. In deze actieve, hands-on rol (circa 90% fysiek en 10% administratief) ben je continu in beweging. Je verzorgt het transport van hoogwaardige onderdelen en machinebodies van en naar luchtlocks en cleanroomcabines. Je reinigt, verpakt en controleert onderdelen volgens strikte cleanroomprotocollen. Je werkt in een gestructureerd 2-ploegenrooster waarin je profiteert van aantrekkelijke toeslagen en een uitstekend salaris tot € 4.200,- bruto per maand. Jouw Werkzaamheden Veilig en gecontroleerd transporteren van hoogwaardige materialen en componenten door de cleanroom. Ondersteunen bij het manoeuvreren en transporteren van machinebodies naar luchtlocks en montagecabines. Zorgvuldig reinigen, cleanroom-verpakken en controleren van modules op kwaliteit, volledigheid en productspecificaties. Beheren van de in- en uitgifte van gereedschappen, kwetsbare onderdelen en verpakkingsmaterialen voor interne teams. Laden en lossen van inkomende en uitgaande goederen met behulp van een elektrische pallettruck (EPT). Signaleren van logistieke knelpunten en aandragen van praktische verbetervoorstellen. Werktijden & Rooster (2-ploegen) Ochtenddienst: 06:30 – 15:30 uur Avonddienst: 15:00 – 24:00 uur 1 weekenddienst per 4 weken (met een nader af te stemmen flexibele roosterdag/springdag) Functie-eisen Je hebt een hands-on instelling, werkt uiterst secuur en voelt je comfortabel in een strikte cleanroomomgeving. Omdat je intensief samenwerkt met internationale engineers en monteurs, beschik je over sterke communicatieve vaardigheden. Opleiding & Niveau: Minimaal een afgeronde mbo 2- of 3-opleiding, bij voorkeur in de logistieke of technische richting. Ervaring: Minimaal 2 jaar relevante logistieke of operationele werkervaring (ervaring in een cleanroom of hightech omgeving is een sterke pré). Fysieke fitheid: Je vindt het prettig om een actieve en fysieke werkdag te hebben (circa 90% fysieke handelingen). Taalbeheersing: Goede beheersing van de Engelse taal is een vereiste; Nederlands is een mooie pré. Eigenschappen: Nauwkeurig, proactief, kwaliteitsgericht en een betrouwbare teamspeler. Flexibiliteit: Bereidheid om in het 2-ploegenrooster te werken inclusief 1 weekenddienst per 4 weken. Arbeidsvoorwaarden Een toonaangevende rol binnen een internationale topwerkgever met uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden: Salaris: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 3.900,- en € 4.200,- (inclusief ploegentoeslag), afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring. Toeslagen: Aantrekkelijke toeslagen voor het werken in een 2-ploegendienst en weekenddiensten. Reiskostenvergoeding: Volledige reiskostenregeling voor jouw woon-werkverkeer. Ontwikkeling: Toegang tot interne trainingen, opleidingstrajecten en volop mogelijkheden om door te groeien binnen ASML. Faciliteiten: Werken met geavanceerde tools in een hypermoderne cleanroomomgeving met hoogwaardige campusfaciliteiten. Begeleiding: Persoonlijke loopbaancoaching en begeleiding via Continu Professionals. Info over het bedrijf ASML is wereldwijd marktleider in lithografiesystemen voor de halfgeleiderindustrie. Vrijwel alle geavanceerde microchips die gebruikt worden in smartphones, datacenters, automotive en medische technologieën worden gemaakt met de machines die in Veldhoven worden ontwikkeld en gebouwd. Binnen de organisatie heerst een dynamische, internationale en no-nonsense cultuur waarin teamwork en innovatie centraal staan. Iedereen deelt dezelfde drive: het onmogelijke mogelijk maken op de vierkante nanometer. Als cleanroom operator speel jij hierin een tastbare, onmisbare rol aan de basis van het assemblageproces.

review_candidates.title: Technical Customer Engineer
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Customer Engineer based in Spain. As a Technical Customer Engineer, you’ll own complex technical support and client-facing problem solving across a global fintech environment. You’ll operate at the L2/L3 level, investigating issues across APIs, transaction data, account systems, and observability tools. The role combines deep technical troubleshooting with long-term client partnership, ensuring problems are resolved rather than simply closed. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, and Customer teams to turn client issues into actionable improvements and identify risks before they become incidents. The team operates globally and asynchronously, with meaningful exposure to payments, card issuing, KYC, and API integrations. You’ll also have opportunities to build internal tools and improve investigation workflows using modern AI-assisted development practices. This is a high-ownership role for someone who enjoys technical complexity, client interaction, and having a direct influence on product quality. Accountabilities Own L2/L3 technical support during EMEA business hours, taking complex client issues from initial triage and investigation through resolution and follow-up. Investigate technical issues across multiple systems, using transaction data, API logs, account information, and observability platforms to identify root causes accurately. Diagnose and reproduce API and integration issues using tools such as Postman, curl, SQL, and system logs. Lead Engineering escalations by preparing structured evidence, technical sub-tickets, and clear summaries of client impact so engineering teams can act efficiently. Build trusted relationships with clients by providing clear technical guidance, proactive communication, and end-to-end ownership of their issues. Identify recurring support patterns, product gaps, integration risks, and potential incidents, proactively sharing findings with Engineering and Product teams. Act as a bridge between clients, Customer teams, Engineering, and Product by translating technical issues into clear business and customer context. Create and continuously improve runbooks, escalation procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge base documentation. Participate in high-priority incident response, maintaining accurate timelines and coordinating client communication during critical incidents. Adopt and improve AI-assisted investigation workflows, using AI tools to increase efficiency and developing practical solutions that can benefit the wider technical support team. Build or contribute to internal tools and workflows using AI coding assistants and modern development technologies. Requirements 5+ years of experience in a technical, client-facing role such as L2/L3 technical support, solutions engineering, implementation engineering, Technical Account Management, or forward-deployed engineering, ideally within B2B SaaS or fintech. Strong technical troubleshooting capabilities, including experience working with REST APIs, reproducing issues through Postman or curl, writing basic SQL queries, and interpreting application and system logs. Demonstrated ability to take full ownership of client problems, proactively investigate issues, follow through on escalations, and remain accountable until a solution is reached. Strong client-facing communication skills, with the ability to explain technical problems clearly to technical and executive stakeholders, including CTOs and CEOs. Experience working in global or 24/7 support environments with cross-time-zone collaboration and structured handoffs. Comfortable working EMEA business hours and participating in an occasional weekend and public holiday on-call rotation. Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms such as New Relic, Datadog, or similar tools. Strong written and verbal English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with distributed teams. A proactive, investigative mindset with strong judgment, prioritization, and problem-solving abilities. Experience with payments, card issuing, stablecoins, open banking, or other fintech infrastructure is a plus. Familiarity with PCI DSS or other financial services compliance environments is advantageous. Experience creating internal tooling, runbooks, knowledge systems, or technical enablement resources is beneficial. Comfortable using AI tools regularly for technical investigation, workflow automation, coding, and problem solving. Benefits Fully remote work within a global, distributed team spanning EMEA, APAC, and the Americas. Flexible working environment designed around collaboration across multiple time zones. Opportunity to take ownership of meaningful client relationships and contribute directly to product and engineering improvements. Clear growth opportunities toward broader technical client ownership and increased product influence. Exposure to complex fintech infrastructure, including payments, card issuing, financial operations, KYC, and API integrations. Opportunities to work extensively with AI-assisted investigation, automation, and development tools. Reap Card stipend and remote setup allowance. Collaborative environment with significant autonomy and visibility across the organization. Opportunity to work with modern data, observability, and engineering tooling while solving complex technical problems at scale. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

review_candidates.description: Company Description VIS Global Pty Ltd is a leading provider of enterprise communication and customer experience management solutions, serving organizations across multiple industry sectors. The company delivers state-of-the-art communications technologies, including enterprise voice, unified communication, data networking, video, and customer experience management solutions. The VIS Global team is highly experienced in consulting, designing, implementing, training, and supporting complex communication environments. Applicants can expect to join a specialist organization focused on innovation, reliability, and end-to-end service delivery for enterprise clients. Job Role & Responsibiliity : Work under supervision as part of a 5 to 10-person team, providing technical software, hardware and network problem resolutions to customers. Assist with the diagnosis of problems, determining and implementing appropriate solutions; guiding and/or communicating resolutions to customers. Work Monday – Friday on a variable roster, can be discussed at interview/on offer. Respond to cases logged by Customer, Operations and Automated Ticketing. Adhere to Service Level Agreement response and resolution time requirements. Ensure cases are updated daily, or as per customer Service Level Agreement. Ensure all unresolved issues are escalated via the appropriate escalation path in a timely manner. Comply with Customer change management policy and processes. Follow all documented procedures for resolution and escalation of incidents. Create and maintain all Operational documents for your assigned client. Take ownership and be proactive in identifying areas for improvement within the customer environment. Handover cases and scheduled activities when away on leave or training. Undertake internal training within the scheduled timeframe or as identified in your Training & Development Plan. Retain ownership of Customer issues until resolved, escalated or accepted by another individual. Liaise directly with Customers in a professional and courteous manner on service requests or problems, ensure an understanding of the business impacts associated with problems and keep the Customer informed as part of the resolution process. Always collaborate with other staff and Customers. Assist the Team Lead and Service Delivery Manager as required
